INFRASTRUCTURE_DRAINAGE.rule: Connection/discharge/drainage infrastructure must follow applicable technical-infrastructure requirements and the 2025 amendment where relevant.

WASTEWATER_DISCHARGE.rule: Where QCVN 14:2025/BTNMT applies, discharge limits and project/environmental-license context override Feng Shui.
WASTEWATER_DISCHARGE.scope_guard: The QCVN itself excludes subjects permitted to use onsite treatment under environmental law; never overgeneralize.

verified_examples: public buildings: accessible toilet provision requirements
ACCESSIBLE_TOILET.rule: Do not shrink/move an accessible toilet to satisfy an auspicious sector if accessibility requirements apply.

HEALTH_SANITATION.rule: Sanitation must safely contain/manage excreta and health risks; traditional auspiciousness cannot justify unsafe sanitation.

BUILDING_PHYSICS.rule: No mystical claim substitutes for moisture and sanitation design.
